findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax in an i18next-rendered bundle breaks interpolation
findings.body:
The account UI (keycloak.v3) renders these messages with i18next, which interpolates `{{0}}`-style placeholders. Every other error message in this file still uses `{{0}}`.

The new value `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.` uses Java MessageFormat placeholders and a `choice` format. i18next does not understand either. Users will see the literal text `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` instead of the attribute name and limits.

The change appears to have been made only to satisfy the new HTML verifier, since the `<` inside the choice is whitelisted for this key. It should be reverted to the `{{0}}` form, or use i18next pluralization.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched to Java MessageFormat, which i18next won't interpolate
findings.body:
The admin UI (keycloak.v2) is a React app that uses i18next with `{{n}}` placeholders. `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` to `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` plus `{2,choice,...}`.

When the admin console shows this validation error, it will display raw placeholders and the choice pattern instead of the substituted values.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body:
`loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian (lt) bundle is now `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users setting up OTP will see a sentence in the wrong language.

It needs a proper Lithuanian translation. Alternatively, drop the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Lithuanian account translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with the Italian sentence `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`. Lithuanian users will see Italian text in the account console.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text placed in Simplified Chinese bundle
findings.body:
`totpStep1` in `messages_zh_CN` (Simplified Chinese) is now `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`. That is Traditional Chinese (手機, 應用程式), which is inconsistent with the rest of the file.

The Simplified form would be something like `在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：`.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart crashes the plugin with an unchecked RuntimeException
findings.body:
`verifySafeHtml` derives the English file path with string replacements. If that file does not exist, it throws a `RuntimeException`.

The path can be missing in several cases:
- a custom or community-only theme with no `_en` file;
- a locale name that the `_[a-zA-Z-_]*` regex does not rewrite as expected.

The exception escapes `verify()`, which only converts `IOException` into `MojoExecutionException`. The build therefore aborts with a stack trace instead of a clean mojo error or a reported message.

The same applies to the read failure of the file itself at line 70.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message omits key and file
findings.body:
The message `Didn't find anchor tag ... in original string` does not include the property key or the file path. Every other message from this class includes both.

When the verifier runs over hundreds of files, the reported error cannot be traced to its source.

findings.title: No test that legitimate HTML/anchors pass without errors
